title: Welcome to November at The Anchor
preheader: Three nights out this month, and Christmas sittings start on Tuesday 10 November.

data.alt: The Anchor, Stanwell Moor Village, since 1751. Poppies and winter greenery around the wordmark.

data.heading: Welcome to November
body: Dark by five, which is the whole point of a pub with the fire on. There are three nights out this month, and the first Christmas sittings start on Tuesday 10 November.
If you are thinking about a Christmas meal with work or with family, now is the time to pick a date. We take bookings from four guests up, right through to 20 December.

events.name: Sparks & Sparklers Quiz Night
events.detail: 7pm start, £3 cash on arrival, teams of up to six. A £25 bar voucher for the winners.

image.alt: Sparks and Sparklers Quiz Night at The Anchor in Stanwell Moor

events.name: Sequins & Showstoppers Music Bingo
events.detail: 7pm start, £5 cash on arrival. Ballroom classics and glitterball anthems, Nikki hosting.

image.alt: Sequins and Showstoppers Strictly-season music bingo at The Anchor

events.name: Snowball Showdown Cash Bingo
events.detail: 7pm start, £10 cash a book. Ten games, a rollover Snowball and a cash jackpot at the end.

image.alt: Snowball Showdown Cash Bingo at The Anchor in Stanwell Moor

data.heading: When we are open
data.footnote: Last orders are 30 minutes before the kitchen closes and 15 minutes before the bar does. Every date in November runs these hours.

image.alt: A Sunday roast at The Anchor in Stanwell Moor

cards.heading: Sunday roast
cards.body: 1pm to 6pm every Sunday, last seating 5.30pm. Nothing to pre-order and no Saturday cutoff.

image.alt: A Christmas dinner laid out at The Anchor

cards.heading: Christmas starts 10 Nov
cards.body: Sittings run to 20 December, from four guests up, with a £10 per person deposit.

data.heading: Coming in December
body: Tinsel & Trivia Quiz Night on Wednesday 2 December, Sleigh My Name Festive Music Bingo on Friday 11 December, and a Christmas Jackpot Cash Bingo on Wednesday 16 December. Our hours change over Christmas and New Year, and we will set all of that out in the December email.

data.body: A quiz team, a bingo book, or a Christmas table booked before the good dates go. Book ahead or just turn up.

data.reason_for_contact: You are receiving this because you have booked with us before, or because you said you would like to hear from us. That may have been a while ago now, and we are glad you are still with us.
